'''Pokémon: Beyond the Skies of the Adventure''' (Italian: '''Pokémon: oltre i cieli dell'avventura''') is the opening theme song for the {{pmin|Italy|Italian-language}} dub of the [[S02|second season]] of {{aniseries|PTS}} as distributed by Mediaset. It was used from [[EP052]] to [[EP105]] (to [[EP116]] in the first airing). It is sung, at some points, to the tune of [[Pokémon (song)|the first opening theme]].

The opening animation mainly consists of clips from various episodes of the season, but also footage from the first two English themes [[Pokémon Theme]] and {{so|Pokémon World}}.

==Trivia==
* This is the only Italian theme song for which the shortened TV version features a part of the lyrics not present in the extended version. However, this part is present in the full version. 
* The "{{tt|Oltre i cieli dell'avventura|Beyond the Skies of the Adventure}}" subtitle that shows up under the "Pokémon" logo doesn't appear during the ending credits.
* [[Giorgio Vanni]] revealed that he was the one who came up with the line "{{tt|La libertà è un'avventura che non finisce mai|Freedom is a never-ending adventure}}" in the first verse. It was proposed to Alessandra Valeri Manera, who kept it and wrote the rest of the song.<ref>Bim Bum Bam Story Vol. 2</ref>
